mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nurse ( staff_id, user_id, staff_name, age, gender, phone, salary, department_id, shift, active ) VALUES ( #{staffId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{salary}, #{department.departmentId}, #{shift}, #{active} )
mapper.select:
SELECT n.staff_id, n.staff_name, n.age, n.gender, n.phone, n.salary, n.department_id, n.shift, n.active,
d.department_name, d.location AS department_location
FROM nurse n
LEFT JOIN department d ON n.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE n.staff_id = #{staffId} and n.active=true

SELECT n.staff_id, n.staff_name, n.age, n.gender, n.phone, n.salary, n.department_id, n.shift, n.active,
d.department_name, d.location AS department_location
FROM nurse n
LEFT JOIN department d ON n.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE n.active = TRUE
SELECT n.*, d.department_name, d.location AS department_location FROM nurse n LEFT JOIN department d ON n.department_id = d.department_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.active = TRUE
